question.text: The co-ordinates of the foot of the perpendicular from $(0,0)$ upon the line $x+y=2$ are

solution.text: Hints : Let $\mathrm{P}$ be the foot of the perpendicular. P lies on a line perpendicular to $x+y=2$. $\therefore$ Equation of the line on which P lies is of the form : $x-y+k=0$ But this line passes through $(0,0)$. $$ \therefore k=0 $$ Hence, co-ordinates of P may be obtained by solving $x+y=2$ and $y=x$ $$ \therefore x=1, y=1 $$ Hence, $\mathrm{P} \equiv(1,1)$
